de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Sieh, die Völker sind versammelt

lines: Doch der Herr, der thront im Himmel,
Spricht sie an in Seiner Zornglut,
Schrecken packt sie wie noch nie.
Dies verkündet Gott, der Herr, klar,
Mit dem Stab der Macht und Herrschaft
Dient dem Herrn, und jauchzt mit Zittern,
Küsst den Sohn, dass Er nicht zürne
Und ihr umkommt auf dem Pfad,
„Wer bei Gott sich birgt, ist selig,
Sahen wir, o Preis sei Dir –
„Wer bei Gott sich birgt, ist selig“,

suplemen.title: Di Buana Nama Yehova Terelok
suplemen.firstLine: Di buana, ya Yehova, eloklah nama-Mu!

lines: Di buana, ya Yehova, eloklah nama-Mu!
Bangsa-bangsa di mana jua, masyhurkan nama-Mu.
Ketika ku tengok pada jagat karya Tuhan,
Surya, bulan, dan s'mua bintang, kisahkan hikmat-Mu.
Dalam rencana-Mu kekal, Kau b'rikan kur-nia-Mu!
Tuhan Yesus, Kaulah Allah ba-ur d'ngan ma-nu-sia,
Mengenakan tubuh daging dan rendahkan diri.
Kini Kaulah Sang pe-ngua-sa, bermahkota mu-lia,
Demi Tubuh-Mu ber-dau-lat, s'mua takluklah kini!
Firman menjelma ma-nu-sia, mati, bangkit, t'rangkat;
Kua-sa, Tubuh, keraja-an, s'mua t'lah Kau genapkan.
D'ngan pekerja-an ilahi Kau bangun puji-an;
Girang lu-ap hati kami, puji Kau yang layak.
O, hari bah'gia s'gra tiba, s'mua mulut bergita!
Tapi kini dalam g'reja, nikmatnya ku rasa.
O, eloklah di bu-a-na, nama-Mu Yehova!
Biar bangsa-bangsa di du-nia, siar nama-Mu indah!
La luna͜ y las estrellas mil
¿Y͜ el hijo de hombre a quien
Quien con la carne se vistió
Y por Tu Cuerpo todo͜ está
Mas en la͜ iglesia hoy está

en.name: English
en.title: O Lord, our Lord, how excellent

lines: O Lord, our Lord, how excellent
Thy name in all the earth!
Let every people, tribe, and tongue
Out of the mouth of little ones
That Thou may still Thine enemy
The work of Thy great hand—
The moon and stars which Thou ordained
O what is man that Thou should’st care
The son of man Thou visitest
O Jesus Lord, Thou art that man,
The One who joined our race,
Who put upon Himself the flesh
But now with glory Thou art crowned,
Now through Thy Body Thou dost rule
By all these steps of work divine
Oh, soon that blessed day shall come—
All tongues these words shall peal!
But in the local churches now
O Lord, our Lord, how excellent
Thy name in all the earth!
Let every people, tribe, and tongue
Ano ba ang tao sa Iyo’t

suplemen.title: Allah Bangkit Musuh Terserak
suplemen.firstLine: Dia bangkit, musuh terserak, pembenci-Nya larilah.

lines: Dia bangkit, musuh terserak, pembenci-Nya larilah.
Luluh lantak orang jahat, depan hadirat Allah.
Giranglah orang benar, sorak menang semarak.
Nyanyi puji, sorak lantang, tinggikan nama-Nya.
Lintas padang kereta-Nya, bebaskan ka-um papa,
Orang yang sebatang kara, menemukan rumahnya;
Yang tertawan lepas sudah, nikmat berkat tak batas.
Bagi kawanan domba, berkat, rahmat, se-di-a!
Tuhan kini menang megah, sebarkan kejaya-an;
Tanpa peluh dan lelah, bagi-bagi jarahan!
Tengok, Kristus t'rangkat sudah, bawa banyak tawanan;
Itulah pem-be-ri-an-Nya, bagi Allah dan insan.
Kita se-mua adalah tawanan yang terubah!
Puji syukur sampai kekal, suplai indah tak kurang;
Dia-lah Allah Penyelamat, sua-ra pu-jian me-lu-as!
Berwisata ke barzakh, kepala musuh pecah!
Allah, kami telah nampak, di ruang kudus – Kau jalan;
Parade nan menang, jaya, serta musik iringan.
Sua-ra pu-jian di depan, panjat ulang-berulang,
Bungsu – Benyamin di depan, Yehuda menyusulnya;
Putra duka di kanan-Nya, singa pemegang kua-sa.
Zebulon dan Naftali, warta kabar gembira:
Hai, umat-Nya, ke-kuat-an-mu dari ba-it nan mu-lia;
Mohon Allah me-ngu-atkan, sampai kami tergenap.
Puji syukur tak henti, hingga ke ujung bumi;

è rén jiàn shén miàn jiù xiāo miè，

en.name: English
en.title: God shall rise, His foes be scattered

lines: God shall rise, His foes be scattered,
All that hate Him flee away.
As the wax before the fire,
All the wicked He shall slay.
He is riding through the deserts,
Bringing in His saints in need.
He’s a Father to the orphans
Here the lone have found a family,
Now the Lord in mighty triumph
No more sweat and dreary toil;
We at home divide the spoil!
Lo, on high Christ hath ascended,
These as gifts He has perfected
That the Lord may dwell with them.
Day by day He loads with good,
E’en the God of our salvation—
His the goings forth from death,
They have seen, O God, Thy goings
Midst a mighty voice of praise.
Son of sorrow at God’s right hand,
Saints, thy strength has been commanded
Still we pray that God may strengthen
All that He has wrought for us.
Higher yet our praise shall rise
Ang Iyong mga lakad O Diyos

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Gott steht auf, zerstreut die Feinde

lines: Gott steht auf, zerstreut die Feinde,
So wie Wachs schmilzt vor dem Feuer,
Preist Ihn! Jah zieht durch die Wüsten,
Ist ein Vater für die Waisen
Er bringt sie in Gottes Wohnung –
Gott in Seinem Haus lässt wohnen,
Und wer einsam ist, zieht ein;
Für die Herde, die Gott leitet,
Schweiß und Müh gibt's nicht mehr heute,
Wir verteiln zu Haus die Beute!
Er hat sie gemacht zu Gaben,
Für Sein Haus, wo Gott einzieht.
Segen sei dem Herrn auf ewig,
Er ist's wert, dass wir Ihn rühmen,
Rettet uns von früh bis spät.
Er – der Ausgang von dem Tod,
O ihr Heil'gen, eure Kraft hat
Was Du hast für uns getan.“
Bis die Erde stimmt mit ein;
То, что сделал Он для нас.

lines: Here der heerscharen, prijst Zijn grote naam,

en.name: English
en.title: Sing aloud your praises to the Lord of all

lines: Sing aloud your praises to the Lord of all,
Now He is dwelling in Jerusalem.
Tell among us all His doings great and small,
His throne, the heavens, yet He walks with men.
Oh, the salvation out of Zion comes;
He brought us back from our captivity.
Now we rejoice and are exceeding glad;
Now we rejoice and are exceeding glad!
In the Holy City with His own He dwells;
O Lord, our Lord, how excellent Thy name!
He’s enthroned upon the praises of His saints;
All His delight in Zion does remain.
The local churches are His move today—
He is our portion, we are satisfied.
Oh, what a goodly heritage have we;
Oh, what a goodly heritage have we!
Who shall in His holy tabernacle dwell,
Who shall ascend to His most holy hill?
Those who seek for Him and purify their heart;
This generation now that seeks His face.
Oh, seek His face, ye children of the earth,
Open your heart, and let the King come in.
He will come in, and He shall live and reign;
He will come in, and He shall live and reign!
Look! God’s tabernacle now is with the saints;
Everything is done, so let His children come;
Christ and the church—where God and man are one!
Lift up your heads, ye cities of the earth;
Open your gates, and let the King come in.
Shout to His praise—He’s coming in to reign!
Shout to His praise—He’s coming in to reign!
Purihin si Kristo kapantay ng Diyos,
Siya’y tamasa ko sa bawa’t minuto,
Kay Kristong Hari ng mga hari.

fr.name: Français
fr.title: Chantons Ses louanges, chantons au Seigneur

lines: Chantons Ses louanges, chantons au Seigneur !
Au lieu choisi, l’église, Son bonheur.
À Jérusalem, que Dieu soit célébré !
Avec Son peuple Il désire habiter.
C’est de Sion que paraît le salut !
C’est là que Dieu rassemble Ses élus !
Dans la ville sainte, parmi tous les Tiens,
Ta gloire brille, que Ton nom est saint !
Tu es célébré par toute l’assemblée,
Là, à Sion, Tes désirs sont comblés.
Toute l’église Te suit pas à pas.
Nous témoignons que Tu es notre Roi,
Qui s’élèvera jusqu’au lieu saint de Dieu ?
Qui entrera dans Son temple glorieux ?
Celui qui Te cherche et purifie son cœur,
Celui qui marche devant Toi, Seigneur.
Cherchons Sa face et tournons-nous vers Lui !
Ouvrons nos cœurs, qu’Il y règne aujourd’hui !
N’attendons plus, le Roi veut revenir !
N’attendons plus, le Roi veut revenir !
Tout est accompli : Dieu est avec les Siens,
Son tabernacle est l’œuvre de Ses mains.
Christ est le vainqueur ! Enfants de Dieu, voyez !
Levons nos têtes, Christ revient régner !
Crions de joie, Son règne est éternel !
Crions de joie, Son règne est éternel !
Oh, cantai louvores ao Senhor dos céus,
Sim, os céus tão altos são o trono Seu,
Mas anda entre nós aqui também.
Nos retirou de tão cruel prisão.
Quão excelente é o nome Teu!
Na Cidade Santa mora com os Seus,
E em Sião tem o deleite Seu.
Sim, as igrejas são o Seu mover;
Está contente, e nos dá prazer.
Oh, que herança rica temos nós;
Oh, que herança rica temos nós!
Quem subirá ao monte do meu Deus?
Os que guardam puro o seu coração;
Os que procuram ver o rosto Seu.
Buscai seu rosto, filhas de Sião,
O rei virá, pra sempre reinará;
O rei virá, pra sempre reinará!
O Seu tabernác’lo com os Seus está;
Cristo e a igreja – Deus e o homem, um!
Abri as portas para vosso Rei;

en.name: English
en.title: Joy, joy, joy in my heart is ringing

lines: Joy, joy, joy in my heart is ringing;
Joy, joy, joy, Jesus sets me singing;
Singing of His mighty love for me,
Telling how He died to set me free,
Filling all my life with melody,
Christ, Christ, Christ in my spirit’s flowing;
Christ, Christ, Christ in my soul is growing,
Burning all the oldness out of me,
Praise, praise, praise, expressing God’s desire;
Praise, praise, praise stirs our spirit’s fire,
Filling all our hearts to overflow,
Telling of His purpose as we go,
Bringing all the wanderers to His flow,
Church, church, church—one in every city;
Church, church, church—divisions what a pity!
Babylon the Great is falling down;
Jerusalem is where the Lord is crowned;
Brothers, won’t you meet on the local ground,
Local church, praise the Lord we’ve seen it,
Local church, praise the Lord we’re in it:
Lighted city set upon a hill—
Christ and the Church—God’s only will;
And this plan He will fulfill

en.name: English
en.title: I stand amazed in the presence

lines: I stand amazed in the presence
And wonder how He could love me,
And my song shall ever be:
Is my Savior’s love for me!
For me it was in the garden,
He prayed: “Not my will, but Thine.”
He had no tears for His own griefs,
But sweat-drops of blood for mine.
And came from the world of light
To strengthen Him in the sorrows
He bore for my soul that night.
He took my sins and my sorrows,
He made them His very own;
He bore the burden to Calv’ry,
When with the ransomed in glory
His face I at last shall see,
’Twill be my joy through the ages
To sing of His love for me.
Grande amor que tem por mim!
E não chorou por Si mesmo,
Vou ver o Seu rosto enfim;

Turunan Adam tertebus, dari lembah jatuh,
Dari lembah jatuh. Kini s'lamat, wajar sujud.

en.name: English
en.title: All hail the pow’r of Jesus’ name (Medium)

lines: All hail the pow’r of Jesus’ name!
And crown Him Lord of all!
Ye chosen seed of Israel’s race,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
Sinners, whose love can ne’er forget
Go, spread your trophies at His feet,
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall,

en.name: English
en.title: Sing we the King who is coming to reign

lines: Sing we the King who is coming to reign,
Glory to Jesus, the Lamb that was slain;
Righteousness, peace then His empire shall bring,
Joy to the nations when Jesus is King.
Come let us sing: Praise to our King,
Jesus our King, Jesus our King:
This is our song, who to Jesus belong:
Glory to Jesus, to Jesus our King.
All men shall dwell in His marvelous light,
Races long severed His love shall unite,
Justice and truth from His scepter shall spring,
Wrong shall be ended when Jesus is King.
All shall be well in His kingdom of peace,
Freedom shall flourish and wisdom increase,
Foe shall be friend when His triumph we sing,
Sword shall be sickle when Jesus is King.
Knowledge and fear of the Lord then shall be
As the deep waters that cover the sea;
All things shall be in the splendor of spring
And all harmonious when Jesus is King.
Kingdom of Christ, for thy coming we pray,
Hasten, O Father, the dawn of the day
When this new song Thy creation shall sing,
Satan is vanquished and Jesus is King.

es.name: Español
es.title: Al Rey que viene alabanzas cantad

lines: Al Rey que viene͜ alabanzas cantad,
Paz y justicia Su͜ imperio tra͡erá;
Gloria͜ al Cordero͜ inmolado͜ en la cruz,
Gozo͜ a los pueblos al regir Jesús.
Al Rey dad gloria, dad gloria͜ a Jesús.
Hará Su cetro brotar la verdad,
Todos los hombres morando͜ en Su luz,
Fin de los males al regir Jesús.
Todo lo bueno Su reino tendrá,
A todo mal vencerá Su virtud,
No͜ habrá más guerras al regir Jesús.
Como las aguas del mar han de ser;
Para que͜ apunte el alba su luz,
Y͜ el diablo caiga al regir Jesús.

fa.title: پادشاه می آید تا حکم کند

lines: پادشاه می آید تا حکم کند،
جلال بر عیسی، آن برّۀ ذبح؛
شادی بر قومها، چون عیسی شاه است.
جلال بر عیسی که اوست شاهِ ما.
قومها در عشقش به هم پیوندند،
عدل و راستی از او طلوع کند،
شر پایان گیرد چون او شاه شود.
دشمن، دوست شود در سرودِ فتح،
شمشیر، داس شود چون عیسی شاه است.
سپس شناخت  و ترس از خداوند
و هماهنگ، چون عیسی شاه شود.
زودتر آور، ای پدر، آن روز را
تا خلقت این سرودِ نو خواند
شریر سرکوب شود، و عیسی شاه.
Праведность, мир будут в царстве Его,
Царь наш Иисус, Царь наш Иисус!
С Ним мы одно, воспеваем Его:
Все племена Он в любви примирит.
Зло сокрушит, лишь Он станет Царём.
Царь наш Иисус, Царь наш Иисус!
С Ним мы одно, воспеваем Его:
Дивной свободе в те дни процветать,
Враг станет другом, меч станет серпом
В мирном том царстве с Иисусом-Царём.
Царь наш Иисус, Царь наш Иисус!
С Ним мы одно, воспеваем Его:
Знание Господа в страхе пред Ним
Царь наш Иисус, Царь наш Иисус!
С Ним мы одно, воспеваем Его:
Отче, пусть день тот скорей рассветёт

Tujuh lipat lebih kuat, sungguh limpah, sempurna!

Daging, nafsu terenyah, hempas di luar gereja.
Tujuh Roh diberikan, bawa hayat nan limpah,
Dalam gereja lokal, ku alami pun nikmat.

suplemen.firstLine: Dengan Roh penghakiman, ha-kim-i s'mua yang jahat!

lines: Dengan Roh penghakiman, ha-kim-i s'mua yang jahat!
Bukan diri mencari, Roh-Mu yang menyatakan.
Dengan roh yang membara, bakar habis najisku;
Bakar habis du-ni-a, sampai ludes diriku.
Dengan roh hikmat Tuhan, wahyukan ra-ha-sia-Mu;
Kau akar, carang, bu-ah, isi nan limpah sungguh.
Cara-cara tak guna, kua-sa roh itu perlu.
Dengan roh pengeta-huan, bukan sandar indraku;
Dengan roh tepat, benar, bawaku tempuh jalan;
Tak undur kar'na s'lera, tak b'rubah kar'na susah.
Singkirkan roh tidurku, celik mata ku jaga;
Sudah dekat balik-Mu, moga ku s'lalu si-ap.

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Der Dreieine Gott nun Wohnung in uns macht

lines: Der Dreieine Gott macht Wohnung jetzt in uns
Als der Geist, wunderbar heut in uns.
Wir sind mit dem Herrn vermengt und eins mit Ihm
Durch den Geist, der gibt Leben in uns.
Er ist der Geist, wunderbar heut in uns,
Ja, der Geist, wunderbar heut in uns!
Gott ist in dem Sohn, der Sohn ist jetzt der Geist
Ja, der Geist, wunderbar heut in uns!
„Abba Vater“ ruft nun tief in uns die Stimm
Aus dem Geist, wunderbar heut in uns.
Er, der Geist des Sohnes, welcher schreit zu Ihm
Durch den Geist, der gibt Leben in uns.
Jesus Christus ist der Herr, in uns lebt Er
Als der Geist, wunderbar heut in uns.

Durch den Geist, der gibt Leben in uns.
Nun ist Er der Geist der Wirklichkeit fürwahr,
Als der Geist, wunderbar heut in uns.
Ja, was Christus ist, wird wirklich und so klar
Durch den Geist, der gibt Leben in uns.
Diese Gabe tief in uns wecken wir auf
Durch den Geist, wunderbar heut in uns.
Rufen wir: „Herr Jesus“ - unser Geist springt auf
Durch den Geist, der gibt Leben in uns!
Tin-aw nang butang ni Cristo kanato,
Dasigon ta kining gasa’s sulod ta,

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: De Drie-eenheid Zelf kwam tot ons in de Zoon

lines: De Drie-eenheid Zelf kwam tot ons in de Zoon,
Als de Geest woont Hij heden in ons,
Zodat Hij Zich met de mens vermengen kan,
Is Hij heden het leven in ons.
De Geest is wonderbaar heden in ons.
Hij is wonderbaar heden in ons.
God is in de Zoon, de Zoon is nu de Geest.
Hij is wonderbaar heden in ons.
’Abba Vader’ roept de Zoon in onze geest.
Hij is wonderbaar heden in ons.
Wij zijn zonen Gods en dat is onze stand.
Want de Geest getuigt heden in ons.
Jezus Christus is de Heer die in ons woont.
Hij is wonderbaar heden in ons.
Als het Woord genieten wij altijd van Hem.
Zo werkt Hij Zichzelf steeds meer in ons.
Jezus Zelf kwam als de Geest der werkelijkheid
En blijft altijd en eeuwig in ons.
Als wij roepen ’Heer’, hoe onze geest dan springt
Met de Geest van het leven in ons.
Ja Heer, breng ons nu in alle werkelijkheid,
In ’t genot van Uw rijkdom in ons.
Wij willen niet slechts kennis, maar realiteit
Van de heerlijke Christus in ons.

en.name: English
en.title: Now the Triune God has come to dwell within

lines: Now the Triune God has come to dwell within
As the wonderful Spirit in us.
We are mingled with the Lord, we’re one with Him
As the life-giving Spirit in us.
Oh, He’s the wonderful Spirit in us,
He’s the wonderful Spirit in us!
God is in the Son, the Son’s the Spirit now—
He’s the wonderful Spirit in us!
“Abba Father” is the cry from deep within
From the wonderful Spirit in us.
’Tis the Spirit of the Son who cries to Him
As the life-giving Spirit in us.
Jesus Christ the Lord is living now in us
He has been transfigured, we enjoy Him thus,
Now the Spirit of reality is here
Now the things of Christ are all so real and clear
We will all stir up this gift that’s deep within
As the wonderful Spirit in us.
When we call “Lord Jesus” how our spirits spring
With this life-giving Spirit in us!
Ang Diyos ay nasa Anak, ang Anak ay
Na siyang Espiritu ng Anak tunay
Malinaw at tunay bagay ni Kristo,

lines: Le Dieu trinitaire vit dans notre esprit,

Christ est devenu l’Esprit de vérité,

Hoje somos um espír’to co’o Senhor,

O Espír’to da vida em nós.

Vive o Senhor em nosso interior,
Como o Espírito excelente em nós.
Como o Espír’to da vida em nós.
Eis o Espír’to da realidade aqui
Como o Espírito excelente em nós.
Pelo Espír’to da vida em nós.
Como o Espírito excelente em nós.

en.name: English
en.title: Th’ anointing’s here! The Lord is moving now in us

lines: Th’ anointing’s here! The Lord is moving now in us;
The ointment dear to us has been applied.
His blood prevails! It gives to us the fellowship,
And now we have the living flow of life.
Th’ anointing’s here! O Christian brothers,
Th’ anointing’s here! We have believed.
Within our spirit, the Spirit’s moving,
And this from Him we have received.
Th’ anointing’s here! O Christian sisters,
The flow within will never cease.
As He anoints us, we are abiding—
Th’ anointing’s here! ’Tis God Himself that blends with us,
And now the two are mingled into one.
And hour by hour we live, and move, and have our life
In God Himself—the Spirit through the Son.
Th’ anointing’s here! It teaches us in everything;
The sense of life we always have within.
Obey this sense, and you will know what you must do,
And live by Life—Yes, clear in everything.

lines: In the Word of God I found it,
I need not man’s natural teaching,
Yes, in my spirit now He is moving!
God at His pure Word I take;
As the Spirit joined unto me,
Based upon the blood that cleanses
Christ, the ointment, moves within me!
For His move I’m made so clean.

He the Holy One anoints me
Till in spirit we’re the same.
God in Spirit; I can touch Him;
In my spirit He’s the flow.
Oh, the very God I know!
He is teaching, He is reaching,
Even all my heart to win.

Deus já flui em mim, sim!

Em meu ser, que é Seu lar.

Dios en Cristo es la vida
Como͜ el Santo El nos unge
El me͜ enseña, El me͜ alcanza
Y se adueña de mi ser.

en.name: English
en.title: Christ liveth in me

lines: Once far from God and dead in sin,
No light my heart could see;
But in God’s Word the light I found,
As rays of light from yonder sun,
The flow’rs of earth set free,
So life and light and love come forth
As lives the flow’r within the seed,
As in the cone the tree,
So, praise the Christ of truth and grace,
With longing all my heart is filled,
That like Him I may be,
As on the wondrous thought I dwell

De même Christ en moi produit
Christ a été en moi semé,
Il vit, grandit, se forme en moi,
Quand je pense à ce fait glorieux,

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Einst fern von Gott, in Sünde tot

lines: Einst fern von Gott, in Sünde tot,
Kein Licht mein Herz sah hier;
In Gottes Wort doch fand ich Licht,
So Leben, Licht und Liebe kommt
Vom Herrn, der lebt in mir.
Die Blume lebt im Samen drin,
Der Baum, der lebt im Kern.
So wohnt in mir, wie wunderbar,
Mit Sehnen wird mein Herz erfüllt,
Ich möcht Ihm gleich sein hier;
In mir nur ein Gedanke wohnt:
Sem vida e luz em mim;
Tal qual o sol em seu fulgor
Hão de brotar luz, vida, amor
És grão de trigo que morreu
Muerto͜ y sin luz en mí;
Pero͜ en la Biblia luz hallé,
Tal como͜ aquella luz de sol,
Amor y vida͜ han de brotar
Del Cristo que vive͜ en mí.
Como͜ en el cono͜ un árbol hay,

suplemen.title: Kristus adalah Benih Hayat
suplemen.firstLine: Tuhan benih hayat tertabur dalam hatiku.

lines: Tuhan benih hayat tertabur dalam hatiku.
Dia bertunas, tumbuh besar jadi p'ra-wak-an-Nya.
Dia perlu air hidup, tak perlu cara, aturan,
hayat yang amuhit membu-at-nya tumbuh besar.
Benih hayat a-ja-ib, yakni Yesus Tuhan,
Dia tertabur dalamku, tumbuh besar dan matang.
Kita butir gandum bukan se-ma-u sendiri,
Se-mua butir gandum 'kan digiling sampai halus;
Gandum jadi tepung halus, bahkan satu roti,
Se-mua orang saleh ba-ur jadi satu Tubuh.
Kita perlu digiling hingga hilang ego,
Butir gandum digiling, satu Tubuh terbentuk.
Benih t'lah tertanam, gandum tumbuh besar matang,
Kita ladang Allah, tumbuh dalam ke-esa-an,
Allah insan bersemayam tak lagi kelana.
Hayat untuk bangunan, Allah insan lega,
Di sini Dia dan umat rukun tinggal bersama.
Untuk pengubahan, tepung halus perlu d'rita;
Gandum tak dapat berhenti pada pu-as diri,
Harus berubah jadi emas, perak, permata.
Tuhan mu-lia bangkit dari mati, lewat d'rita,
Moga Tuhan jaga aku miskin di dalam roh,
Agar jadi tanah ba-ik, benih tumbuh, limpah.
Dapat mustika tak ternilai, yakni Mempelai.
Tuhan kosongkan rohku, tulus, murni, suci,
Hayat matang menjadi memp'lai p'rem-puan terkasih.

tl.name: Tagalog
tl.title: Sa puso natin hinasik ang binhi ng buhay

lines: Sa puso natin hinasik ang binhi ng buhay
Nang puspos lumago maging kanyang kapareha
Binhi’y tubig kailangan di batas o ang porma
Binhing nagpapaloob ng lahat ay lalago!
Magbubunga ng trigo ang paglago ni Kristo
Buhay sisibol, di pa ganap gawang dibino;
May  bagong karanasan kapag butil naghalo.
Di dapat paligtasin ang ‘sang butil ng trigo,
Hanggang ang trigo ay maging pagkaing nabuo
Upang naghalong banal mahubog sa Katawan.
Naging pagkain binhing tanim, trigong lumago
Sa bukid ng Diyos mga Kristiyano ay lalago;
Paglago’y para sa pagtatayo ng ekklesia,
Paghanap kapwa’y natapos ng may tahanan na.
Transpormasyong di masambit na init, pasakit
Di masyahan manatili na lamang pagkain
Kunin ang transpormasyon nang maging isang bato.
Mula sa ganap na paglago at transpormasyon
Isang payak, hiyas na perlas ang lumalabas.
Natanto sa kamatayan, binuo ng buhay
Bunga Nyang malwalhati ang ekklesia, ang Nobya.
Paglago sa buhay nagsimula nang tinanim
Binhing lumago, trigong giniling na pagkain,
Lumago binhi ng buhay sa mabuting lupa,
Hanggang marating huling yugto at masyahan Ka
Mataglay Mo mahal, piniling perlas, ang Nobya.
Um lar pra Deus e nós,
Pra que a semente gere flor;

suplemen.title: Kerajaan Ialah Kristus Sendiri
suplemen.firstLine: Kami nampak maksud hati-Mu, pada keraja-an.

lines: Kami nampak maksud hati-Mu, pada keraja-an.
Tidak perlu berjerih bodoh, sandar kur-nia saja.
Tidak perlu tunggu kelak, kami masuk keraja-an.
Asal Dikau tumbuh dalamku, k'ra-ja-an 'kan nyata.
Keraja-an per-luas-an Kristus, benih t'lah tertabur;
Yesus itulah benih hayat, teruslah bertumbuh.
Batu, tanah — hayat jiwa; semak duri — kua-tir harta;
Jangan jadi pinggiran jalan; jadi tanah subur.
Tanah subur, gandum bertumbuh, menghasilkan bu-ah;
Gandum harus menjadi tepung, pangan Allah, insan.
Jadi kurban saji-an kudus, satu dalam Tuhan.
Lewat d'rita, ubah ke batu, bagi pembangunan!
Di dalam Roh tumbuh, berubah, 'mas, perak, permata.
T'rima Tuhanlah pribadi, mengendali hidup kita;
Demi hayat tumbuh, berubah, keraja-an nyata.
Muti-ara murni sempurna, mutu paling tinggi;
Walau d'rita bertubi-tubi, hayat tumbuh tinggi.
Tuhan hayat dan pribadi, k'ra-ja-an – Tuhan sendiri;
Dalam kita tumbuh tak henti, Allah-insan s'rasi.

zh.name: 简体中文
zh.title: 基督是我们人位

lines: 我的旧人已经被废除，在十架上已与主同死；
现在他再无任何用处，对我他已故。
我的新人在我灵里住，在我里面如活井涌出，
以祂丰盛生命来充满我的每一部。
基督在我灵里作人位，我心天天向祂不别归，
好让里面的人有个家：一个地方可以安息，
那里是我完全的实际，将祂所是向我全开启，
丰丰富富居住我心里，作我真人位。
pinyinLines: wǒ de jiù rén yǐ jīng bèi fèi chú， zài shí jià shàng yǐ yǔ zhǔ tóng sǐ；
xiàn zài tā zài wú rèn hé yòng chù， duì wǒ tā yǐ gù。
wǒ de xīn rén zài wǒ líng lǐ zhù， zài wǒ lǐ miàn rú huó jǐng yǒng chū，
yǐ tā fēng shèng shēng mìng lái chōng mǎn wǒ de měi yī bù。
jī dū zài wǒ líng lǐ zuò rén wèi， wǒ xīn tiān tiān xiàng tā bù bié guī，
hǎo ràng lǐ miàn de rén yǒu gè jiā： yí gè dì fāng kě yǐ ān xī，
yí gè dì fāng chéng wéi tā de ─
nà lǐ shì wǒ wán quán de shí jì， jiāng tā suǒ shì xiàng wǒ quán kāi qǐ，
fēng fēng fù fù jū zhù wǒ xīn lǐ， zuò wǒ zhēn rén wèi。

lines: 借这人位成形在我里，我成祂身上的一肢体，
所有行动都不再单独，全在配搭里。
基督必须是我们人位，我们天然个性须拆毁，
天天拆毁直到拆干净，基督作一切！
惟有基督是我们人位，再无自己的愿望目的，
直到召会是基督自己，建造成为一个新人，
神人完完全全的调和，得到一个合式的居所，
建立起祂国度的权柄，在这全地上。
不是单单基督的自己，还有召会同配合为一，
取用基督自己作一切，成一个新人。
pinyinLines: jiè zhè rén wèi chéng xíng zài wǒ lǐ， wǒ chéng tā shēn shàng de yī zhī tǐ，
suǒ yǒu xíng dòng dōu bù zài dān dú， quán zài pèi dā lǐ。
jī dū bì xū shì wǒ men rén wèi， wǒ men tiān rán gè xìng xū chāi huǐ，
tiān tiān chāi huǐ zhí dào chāi gān jìng， jī dū zuò yī qiè！
wéi yǒu jī dū shì wǒ men rén wèi， zài wú zì jǐ de yuàn wàng mù dì，
zhí dào zhào huì shì jī dū zì jǐ， jiàn zào chéng wéi yí gè xīn rén，
shí xiàn shén de yǒng yuǎn zhǐ yì ─
shén rén wán wán quán quán de tiáo hé， dé dào yí gè hé shì de jū suǒ，
jiàn lì qǐ tā guó dù de quán bǐng， zài zhè quán dì shàng。
bú shì dān dān jī dū de zì jǐ， hái yǒu zhào huì tóng pèi hé wèi yī，
qǔ yòng jī dū zì jǐ zuò yī qiè， chéng yí gè xīn rén。

en.name: English
en.title: My old person has been nullified

lines: My old person has been nullified;
With my Lord upon the cross he died;
Now in nothing shall he be applied;
My new Person in my spirit dwells;
Springing in me as a bubbling well;
Flowing out until each part He fills
Christ, my Person, in my spirit lives;
And my heart to Him I’d daily give;
That my inner man could have a home
And a place to settle down, yes,
A place to call His own, and—
There expressing all He is to me,
By this Person being formed in me,
I’ll a member of His Body be,
More and more our Person He must be;
Only Christ, our Person, must remain;
From our aims, our goals we must refrain,
Till the church be only Christ Himself
Built up as the one new man,
Thus fulfilling God’s great plan of—
Mingling fully with the human race
To obtain a proper dwelling place,
Taking Christ as all in all, to be

fr.name: Français
fr.title: Mon vieil homme a été crucifié

lines: Mon vieil homme a été crucifié,
En Jésus-Christ à la croix cloué,
Il ne peut pas être amélioré,
Quelqu’un vit en moi et m’affranchit,
Une vie nouvelle en moi jaillit,
Chaque jour, de Lui je suis rempli.
Sa Personne habite en mon esprit,
Il désire que je m’ouvre à Lui,
Et de moi rayonnera Sa vie.
Qu’Il habite dans mon cœur et y fasse Sa demeure,
Qu’Il remplisse et gagne mes pensées !
Par Sa vie qui croît, prend forme en moi,
Je ne suivrai plus mes propres voies,
À la Tête, nous restons soumis,
Le dessein de Dieu, Son grand désir.
L’univers admirera en nous Christ dans Son éclat et
Il n’y aura plus jamais de nuit.
Dieu à Ses élus sera uni
Dans la ville coule l’eau de vie,
L’arbre de la vie produit Ses fruits,

pt.name: Português
pt.title: O meu velho homem pereceu

lines: Lá na cruz com meu Senhor morreu;
Cristo, a Pessoa nova em mim,
Tal Pessoa, Cristo, vive em mim,
Eu Lhe dou meu coração enfim,
Expressando o que é pra mim,
Tal Pessoa é formada em mim,
Sou um membro do Seu Corpo, sim,
Pra que tudo velho em meu ser
Só Jesus assim em nós ficar,
Pra igreja ser só Cristo, sim,
O mesclar do homem e de Deus
Pra ganhar um lar que seja seu,
En la cruz con el Señor murió;
Mi nueva Persona vive͜ en mí;
Y mi corazón a El le doy,
Expresar lo que͜ El es para mí,
Y que͜ habite en mi corazón,
Me͜ hace miembro de Su Cuerpo͜ así,
Mi Persona siempre͜ El debe ser,
Y mis metas tengo que dejar,
Sólo Cristo la͜ iglesia͜ ha de ser
No lo͜ hará de modo͜ individual,
Mas la͜ iglesia͜ en forma corporal,

lines: 주님 십자가에 죽을 때 내 옛 사람도 다 끝났네
내 영 안에 사는 새 사람 샘물처럼 솟아 오르네
내 각 부분 채울 때까지 넘쳐 흐르네
내 영 안에 사는 주님께 매일 내 마음 다 드리리
그가 안식하는 집을 얻게 하기 위해
완전한 실재를 누리며 그의 모든 것 나타내리
내 인격 되신 주가 내 맘에 충만히 거할 때
완전한 실재를 누리며 그의 모든 것 나타내리
내 인격 되신 주가 내 맘에 충만히 거할 때
주 인격 내 안에 새겨질 때 나는 주의 몸의 지첼세
점점 주 내 인격 될 때에 점점 내 옛 성분 나가네
그리스도 나의 모든 것 되는 날까지
오직 그리스도 한 분만 위해 나의 뜻 다 버리네
하나님의 위대한 뜻 한 새사람 이뤄
하나님과 사람 연합해 주 완전한 처소 얻는 날
온 땅에 그의 나라 권위와 은혜 넘치리라
하나님과 사람 연합해 주 완전한 처소 얻는 날
온 땅에 그의 나라 권위와 은혜 넘치리라 은혜 넘치리라
Старый человек с меня был снят,
Вместе с Господом он был распят,
Личность в духе у меня — Христос;
Мог дом во мне создать, и
Всё, что есть Он для меня, являть,
Всем Христос для церкви должен быть,
Обретёт как всё во всем Христа,

suplemen.title: Allah Menyatakan Diri Dalam Daging
suplemen.firstLine: Sungguh menang! Sungguh jaya! Allah jadi manu-sia!

lines: Mengenakan sifat insan, agar murad-Nya genap.
Demi salib tumpas Iblis, Anak Manu-sia bangkit!
Yesus demi bajik insan t'lah menahan si licik;
S'ba-gai insan Di-a menang, lewati se-mua u-jian!
Kini dalam roh ku t'rima s'gala kebajikan-Nya.
Dia menjadi hayat insan, yakni dalam Roh Yesus,
Bajik insan jadi putra, d'ngan Roh Allah berba-ur.
Kini Roh ini almuhit, penuhi s'mua perluku.
Sungguh a-jaib! Sungguh ri-il! Anak1 tinggal dalamku!
Me-lu-as ke anteroku, hidup nyata lewatku.
Haleluya! Haleluya! Ku memuji tak putus.
Sungguh a-jaib! Sungguh mu-lia! Atas insan Dia nyata!
Kita ia-lah anggota-Nya, untuk ekspresikan Dia.
Kini hidup bersandar Dia, membangun ke-diam-an-Nya.

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: Wat een overwinning! Glorie!

lines: Brengt Hij ons Zijn plan van heil.
Door de dood heeft Hij de satan
Nu met vreugde, kan ‘k die deugden
In de Geest van deze Jezus
In de Geest van God een feit.
Wat een zegen is Zijn leven
Deze Mens woont nu in mij.
Hij doordringt mij met Zijn leven
Zodat ik ook word als Hij.
Wat een wonder! Wat een glorie!
God, die mens werd op Zijn tijd.
Wij de leden van Zijn lichaam,
En als woning van de Koning

en.name: English
en.title: What a victory! What a triumph

lines: What a victory! What a triumph!
He through death destroyed the devil;
Risen now, the Son of Man!
He as man withstood the tempter,
Now in spirit I can take Him,
In the Spirit of this Jesus
Is His human life so fine.
Such a man now lives in me.
Into all my heart He’s spreading—
He, my human life, to be.
Oh, what wonder! Oh, how glorious!
We the members of His Body
For the building of God’s dwelling
Há tal Homem dentro em mim;
Vive e se expande em mim.
Deus na carne a se mostrar!
Dios un hombre vino͜ a ser,
Este Hombre͜ está͜ en mi ser.
Vive͜ en mí y͜ aun se͜ expande;
En los miembros de Su Cuerpo,

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Welch ein Sieg! Welch Triumphieren

lines: Gott Selbst zog das Menschsein an;
Durch den Tod zertrat Er Satan,
Stand als Mensch dem Feind entgegen,
Heute kann ich zu mir nehmen
Ja, im Geist von Jesus Christus
Welch Versorgung steht im Geist für
Solch ein Mensch lebt nun in mir,
Und mein Leben ist Er hier.
Oh, welch Wunder! Oh, wie herrlich!
Und so bauen wir Sein Haus.

lines: 하나님이 사람 됐네 위대한 계획 이루려
인성 입고 사망 거쳐 마귀- 없이 하셨네
할렐루야 다시 사신 그는 바로 인잘세

사람이신 주 예수는 시험하는 자 이겼네
모든 시험 거친 주를 영 안에서 누리네

이 영 안에 충만있네 넘치는 공급있네
기묘하나 실재일세 그 사람 내 안에 사네

그의 인성 더욱 누려 그의 처소 건축해
حال در روح از او برخوردار،
به وفور در این روح بهرِ
این شخص هست حالا در من.
В плоть и кровь облёкся Он,
И могу принять я в духе
Этот Дух богат, чтоб все мы
О, как чудно! О, как славно!

suplemen.title: Berdasarkan Keinsanian Yesus
suplemen.firstLine: Tengok! Zaman telah ubah, perang telah mu-lai!
suplemen.chorusSnippet: Tegaklah berdasar pada insani Yesus.

lines: Tengok! Zaman telah ubah, perang telah mu-lai!
Ka-um saleh dilengkapi, d'ngan insani Yesus.
Tengok! Iblis datang du-nia, merusak manu-sia;
Tapi Allah pilih seo-rang, nilai-Nya tak tara!
Di-a Yesus, Adam akhir, hancur sia-sat Satan.
Menakutkan, du-nia cemar, dosa makin parah;
Makin m'rosot, tia-da obat, insan bobrok sudah!
Tapi kita umat surga, jadi garam du-nia;
Dalam du-nia serba jahat, terlindung oleh-Nya.
Kini kita makan minum seru nama Tuhan;
Nikmat s'luruh insani-Nya, menginjak si Satan.
O, paling kepada Tuhan, tolak hayat jiwa;
Hancurkan s'mua sia-sat Satan, suplai insan hayat.
Deus, porém, com o Seu plano
Mas nós, filhos do Seu reino,

en.name: English
en.title: Lo, the conflict of the ages

lines: Lo, the conflict of the ages
Let us stand up in Jesus
Lo, how Satan came to damage
But the Lord in all this ruin
Raised a man full of worth!
From the seed of the woman
To the Lord we must be turning,
See the ruin of a nation
But as children of the kingdom
In the midst of such dearth.

zht.name: 繁體中文
zht.title: 憑著耶穌的人性

pinyinLines: kàn nǎ！ shí dài yǐ jīng zhuǎn yí，
zhēng zhàn yǐ jīng kāi shǐ！
nà bèi pàn zhě sā dàn yī huǒ，
xiàn zài qīng cháo ér chū。
suǒ yǐ shèng tú bì xū
jù bèi yé sū wán měi rén xìng，
wèi zhù zhāng xiǎn shén de xíng xiàng，
zhí xíng shén de quán bǐng。
ràng wǒ men píng zhù
yé sū de rén xìng ér zhàn zhù，
yáng yì chū rén xìng měi dé，
chéng wèi zhōng liú dǐ zhù。
zài zhè shì dài， zuì è chāng jué，
wān qū bài huài， bèi nì gāng yìng，
zhào huì bì xū qiáng liè jiàn zhèng
yé sū wán měi rén xìng！
kàn nǎ！ sā dàn lái dào dì shàng，
pò huài rén lèi shēng mìng；
dàn shén cóng zhōng xìng qǐ yī rén，
tā de jià zhí wú bǐ！
cóng zhè yī gè nǚ rén hòu yì，
shén lái chéng wèi ròu shēn，
zhè rén yé sū ─ mò hòu yà dāng ─
cuī huǐ sā dàn guǐ jì。
chù mù jīng xīn， quán dì wū rǎn，
zuì zhōng gǔn xiàng xià pō；
měi kuàng yù xià， jǐ wú yào jiù，
rén xìng hé qí duò luò！
wǒ men què shì tiān guó zi mín，
xiǎn wèi shì shàng de yán，
zài zhè bù fǎ shì dài lǐ miàn，
méng tā rén xìng bǎo quán。
jīn rì wéi yǒu jí zhù chī hē，
zhǔ míng bù duàn hū hǎn；
xiǎng shòu tā de rén xìng suǒ yǒu，
tiān tiān jiàn tà sā dàn。
ó， ràng wǒ men huí zhuǎn xiàng zhǔ，
qì jué hún de shēng mìng；
huǐ huài sā dàn suǒ yǒu jì móu，
gōng yīng xīn rén shēng mìng。

zht.name: 繁體中文
zht.title: 哦願我有千萬舌頭

pinyinLines: ó， yuàn wǒ yǒu qiān wàn shé tóu，
qián lái zàn měi jiù zhǔ，
shuō tā ēn diǎn hé děng shēn hòu，
róng yào hé děng fēng fù。
yé sū zhè míng， wèi wǒ kǔ qíng，
qū jǐn wǒ de jīng qiè，
shì wǒ ān xī、 shì wǒ shēng mìng，
chéng wèi wǒ de yīn lè。
tā yīn ài wǒ， jìng yuàn jīng lì
rén shì suǒ yǒu kǔ chǔ；
tā yǐ xiāo miè zuì de néng lì，
shì fàng zuì de qiú tú。
wǒ měi jìng niàn jiù wǒ de ài，
lì jí gǎn jué bù pèi；
bù zhī tā wèi shén me ēn dài
wǒ zhè rén zhōng zuì kuí。
wǒ jīn zuò tā ài de fú lǔ，
gān xīn zuò dào yǒng jiǔ；

shǐ wǒ dé yǐ zì yóu。
wǒ jì cóng nǐ kě ài de míng，
zhī nǐ dài wǒ měi yì；
jiǎ ruò wǒ yǒu qiān wàn de xīn，
yě dāng yī yī guī nǐ。

zht.pinyinTitle: ó yuàn wǒ yǒu qiān wàn shé tóu

en.name: English
en.title: O for a thousand tongues to sing

lines: O for a thousand tongues to sing
The glories of my God and King,
My gracious Master and my God,
To spread through all the earth abroad,
Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
His love my heart has captive made,
For He was bound, and scourged and died,
He breaks the power of canceled sin,
His blood can make the foulest clean;
So now Thy blessed Name I love,
Thy will would e’er be mine.
Had I a thousand hearts to give,
My Lord, they all were Thine!
Às glórias do meu Deus e Rei,
Por todo o mundo, o nome Teu,
E traz a mim, um pecador,
E Teu querer é o meu;
A propagar por tierra͜ y mar
Rompe͜ el pecado͜ y su poder,
Hasta͜ al más vil puede limpiar

ko.title: 천만의 입이 있-어도 내 구-주 찬미하리-

lines: 천만의 입이 있-어도 내 구-주 찬미하리-
그 깊고 깊은 은-혜와 풍성-한 영-광을
내 고통 위로하는 이름 두려-움 쫓는 이름-
내 안식 나의 생-명과 내 음-악 되-었네
내 주님 날 사랑-하사 고초- 다 겪-었네-
죄 권세 이미 소-멸해 죄에-서 해-방해
그 사랑 생각할- 때에 난 자-격 없-다네-
죄인 중 괴수 어-찌해 주가- 사랑-했나
주 사랑의 포로-되길 난 기-꺼이- 원해-
주님이 나를 대-하신 선한- 뜻 알-기에-
천만 개 마음 있-어도 다 주-께 드-리리

ja.name: 日本語
ja.title: われら千万のしたで, 　すくいぬしさん美し,

lines: われら千万のしたで, 　すくいぬしさん美し,
ながめぐみのふかさ, 　えいこうをかたる。
イェスの名はなぐさめ, 　おそれを取りのぞく;
われの安そく,いのち, 　わがしらべとなる。
われをあいするゆえ, 　すべての苦難受ける;
つみのちからのぞき, 　つみの囚人を解く。
われをすくうあいを, 　いま,しずかにおもう;
つみびとのかしらを 　なにゆえすくうや。
われはいまあまんじて, 　あいのとりことなる;
わがため,かれは死に, 　自由得させるゆえ。
あいすべき名により, 　なれのこころを知る;
こころが千万あれば, 　すべてなれに帰す。
چون او رنج کشید و مُرد تا
Благой Господь мой и мой Бог,
Как песнь у грешника в ушах,
Ведь, бич и смерть приняв, мне Он

lines: 主をあいするもの, よろこび来たれ;

suplemen.title: Dia Kian Hari Kian Indah
suplemen.firstLine: Pada Yesus hati tertarik, rasa kian mes-ra,
suplemen.chorusSnippet: Limpah ruah kaya Tuhan, s'pa-ruh pun tak t'ritung,

lines: Pada Yesus hati tertarik, rasa kian mes-ra,
Dia tercantik, lebi segar dari embun pagi,
Ki-an hari ki-an indah, lam-pau-i kemarin!
Limpah ruah kaya Tuhan, s'pa-ruh pun tak t'ritung,
Dia kian hari kian indah me-le-bih-i yang lalu!
Kita nampak mu-lia-Nya terpancar dalam g'reja,
Di sinilah limpah-Nya, tak perlu cari ke lain,
Di-a selalu memu-askan roh lapar kita,
Dia kian hari kian indah, melebihi yang tadi!
Kini Dia-lah Roh hidup, tinggal dalam roh kita,
B'ri urapan yang manis, hayat roh lebih penuh!
Bila kita bersidang, sungguh bebas roh kita,
Dia kian hari kian indah melebihi yang dulu!
Tampilkan kaya limpah Kristus dan gereja-Nya,
Tercurah pada-Nya milik dan adanya kita,
Bagi rencana-Nya yang agung, lebih mustika!

en.name: English
en.title: To Jesus every day we find our hearts are closer drawn

lines: To Jesus every day we find our hearts are closer drawn;
He’s fairer than the sons of men and fresher than the morn;
He’s all that we can say of Him in fairest words and more,
And every day He’s dearer than He was the day before.
The half cannot be fancied of such a treasure-store,
And every day He’s dearer than He ever was before!
His glory broke upon us when we saw Him in the church,
For here are all His riches, here we’ve given up our search;
’Tis here He satisfies our longing spirits o’er and o’er,
And every day He’s dearer than He was the day before.
Now He’s the living Spirit who within our spirit dwells,
And by His sweet anointing, how His life within us swells!
As with the saints we’re meeting, full released our spirits soar,
For now our Lord is dearer than He ever was before.
The Lord has made us one with Him for His recovery:
The riches of this Christ, the church His fullness, men must see.
Yes, all we have and all we are, we every day outpour
For His tremendous purpose, ever dearer than before.

ceb.name: Cebuano
ceb.title: Matag adlaw kasingkasing nadani kang Jesus

lines: Matag adlaw kasingkasing nadani kang Jesus;
Matahum pa S’ya’s linibo, sa yamog mas bag-o,
Di S’ya ikaasoy’s labing nindot nga pamulong,
Ug labi pa Siyang mahal kay sa kaniadto.
Labi pa Siya nga mahal kay sa kaniadto!
Nakitang himaya N’ya dinhi ra sa iglesia,
Niang kadato N’ya, dili na pangitaon pa;
Dinhi gitagbaw N’yang nangandoy tang espiritu,
Ug labi pa Siyang mahal kay sa kaniadto.
Sa dihog N’ya nangadasig ang kinabuhi ta!
Sa tigum nato espiritu pagkahabog gyud,
Kay labi pa Siyang mahal kay sa kaniadto.
Cristo, iglesia, makita unta’s mga tawo,
Alang’s tuyo N’ya nga mahal kay sa kaniadto!
Siya’y maganda’t sariwa sa umaga, nang higit,
Lalo Siya sa lahat na sa Kanya’y masasambit
Bawa’t araw Siya ay higit na kaibig-ibig.
O hindi masayod na masaganang yaman,
Bawa’t araw Siya ay mas mahal kaysa nagdaan!
Dito ang kayamanan Niya’y aming natagpuan,
Bawa’t araw Siya ay mas mahal kaysa nagdaan.
Siya’y nasa loob namin, ’Spiritung buhay ngayon,
Sa Kanyang pagpapahid ang buhay sumusulong!
Kasama-sama ng mga banal sa pagpulong,
Sapagka’t ngayon Siya ay mas mahal kaysa noon.
Ginagawa ng Pangino’ng tayo’y kaisa Niya,
Para sa Kanyang pagbabawi upang makita
Ng mga tao ang yaman ni Kristo’t ekklesia,
Kaya binibigay namin ang lahat sa Kanya.
Jesus a cada dia atrai o nosso coração;
Ele é mais refrescante que o orvalho da manhã.
Nem as mais belas línguas Seu valor entoarão,
Pois cada dia mais precioso que antes Ele é!
E cada dia mais precioso que antes Ele é!
Ao vê-Lo na igreja, Sua glória em nós raiou;
Aqui há Seus tesouros, nossa busca terminou!
O anelo em nosso espírito, a resposta encontrou:
Achamos o que cada dia mais precioso é!
Ele é o Espír’to vivo que em nós veio habitar,
E por Seu doce ungir faz Sua vida em nós jorrar.
Na reunião o nosso espír’to livre vai alçar,
Pois hoje mais precioso do que ontem Ele é!
Consigo fez-nos um, pra Sua igreja restaurar,
E Sua plenitude no universo expressar.
Sim, o que temos, o que somos, vamos derramar
Por Seu eterno plano, tão precioso para nós.

es.name: Español
es.title: Estamos atraídos cada día a Jesús

lines: Estamos atraídos cada día a Jesús,
Es bello cual ninguno, más radiante que la luz;
Es más de lo que digas o que puedas componer,
Y El se hace más querido͜ al verlo cada vez.
No puede describirse, ni͜ aún a la mitad,
El es como͜ un tesoro que queremos más y más.
Al verle en la͜ iglesia tanta gloria estalló,
Hallando Sus riquezas nuestra búsqueda cesó;
Aquí se satisface nuestro͜ espíritu con El,
Y El se hace más querido͜ al verlo cada vez.
Es el viviente͜ Espíritu que mora͜ en nuestro ser,
Ungiendo nuestro͜ espíritu lo͜ inunda todo El;
Reunidos con los santos nos rebosa͜ el corazón
Por eso lo queremos con entera devoción.
Por Su recobro somos uno hoy con el Señor,
Se͜ exhiben Sus riquezas por la͜ iglesia con fervor;
Todo lo que tenemos nos complace derramar
Para que Su propósito se pueda realizar.

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Zu Sich zieht Jesus unsre Herzen jeden Tag noch mehr

lines: Zu Sich zieht Jesus unsre Herzen jeden Tag noch mehr,
Er ist wie frischer Tau, der Allerschönste ist der Herr;
Es fehlen uns die Worte, Er ist einfach wunderbar,
Und täglich wird Er teurer als Er's jemals vorher war.
Selbst halb so viel des Schatzes ist rein unvorstellbar,
Und täglich wird Er teurer als Er's jemals vorher war!
Als wir Ihn sahen klar und hell in der Gemeinde hier,
Erschien uns Seine Herrlichkeit, welch Reichtum fanden wir;
Gestillt wird hier die Sehnsucht unsres Geistes immerdar,
Und täglich wird Er teurer als Er's jemals vorher war.
Nun wohnt Er als der Geist des Lebens stets in unsrem Geist,
Mit Seiner süßen Salbung uns Sein Leben unterweist!
Befreit fließt unser Geist in der Versammlung wunderbar,
Und täglich wird Er teurer als Er's jemals vorher war.
Der Herr hat uns für Seinen Plan und Herzenswunsch vereint:
Nun die Gemeinde als die Fülle Christi herrlich scheint.
Für diesen Vorsatz geben wir uns Ihm nun völlig dar,
Und täglich wird er teurer als er's jemals vorher war.

ko.name: 한국어
ko.title: 우리 마음은 항상 끌려 주께로 오네

lines: 우리 마음은 항상 끌려 주께로 오네
주의 귀함을 세상 말로 표현 못하리
그 보배로움 매일 매일 더욱 귀하네
놀라운 복의 근원 그 반도 알 수 없네
그의 나타난 영광 교회 안에서 보네
형제 자매여 주의 풍성 여기 있으니
다 와서 먹고 마심으로 맘껏 누리세
주의 산 영이 지금 우리 영 안에 있네
기름 부음이 영의 생명 충만케 하네
우리 영 해방 받아 높이 솟아 오르네
우리 주 이전 보다 더욱 사랑스럽네
주님의 회복 위해 주 나와 연합했네
우리의 모든 소유 전체 주께 바칠 때
Иисус к Себе сердца день ото дня влечёт сильней,
Он лучше, чем сыны земли, и утра Он свежей,
Он больше, чем в прекрасных можно высказать словах,
И каждый день дороже Он для нас, чем был вчера.
В Своей великой славе нам открылся в церкви Он;
Здесь всё Его богатство, здесь наш поиск завершён;
Здесь жажду в нашем духе утоляет Он сполна,
И каждый день дороже Он для нас, чем был вчера.
Он Дух животворящий, в духе нашем Он живёт,
В собранье вольно дух парит и радость так свежа!
Ведь наш Господь сегодня дорог нам как никогда.
В Его восстановлении одно с Ним стали мы:
Богатого Христа и церковь видеть все должны.
Для замысла Его, что нам дороже с каждым днём.

suplemen.title: Pohon Hayat
suplemen.firstLine: Pohon hayat, bu-ah nyaman, penuh limpah Allah.

lines: Dulu mati, kini hidup, lapar jadi kenyang.
Buka mulut, nikmat Kristus, sedapnya tak tara!
Nikmatku yang paling murni, s'lain Dia, tak pu-as.
Demi makan hayat masuk, hidupku sandar Dia.

en.name: English
en.title: The tree of life, how sweet the fruit

lines: The tree of life, how sweet the fruit,
I once was dead, but now I live,
Was starved, but now I eat.
’Twas God that brought me to the tree,
How precious did that tree become
The Lord Himself is food to me,
He will my pure enjoyment be,
I freely eat this living tree,
To put God’s life inside of me,

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: Zoet is ‘t fruit van de levensboom

lines: Zoet is ‘t fruit van de levensboom,
Maar nu, eet en leef ik!
God bracht mij naar de levensboom.
Hoe kostbaar werd die boom voor mij,
Toen ik voor het eerst at.
De Heer Zelf is voedsel voor mij,
Hij is mijn genot, niets anders

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Die Frucht des Lebensbaums ist süß

lines: Verhungert einst, nun ess ich froh,
War tot, nun lebt mein Geist.
Gott Selber brachte mich zum Baum,
Wie kostbar ist der Baum für mich,
Seit ich Ihn ess im Geist!
Der Herr als Speise mich versorgt,
Für mich ist Er allein Genuss,
Ich esse frei von diesem Baum,
Denn Christus essen ist der Weg,
So leb ich durch den Herrn.

pt.name: Português
pt.title: A árvore da vida a mim

lines: A árvore da vida a mim:
Deus já me trouxe à Árvore,
Sim, Ele é o desfrute meu;
Deus põe Sua vida no meu ser,

es.name: Español
es.title: El árbol de la vida es Dios

lines: El árbol de la vida͜ es Dios,
Yo muerto fui, mas vivo hoy,
Al árbol me llevó mi Dios,
Por el comer yo puedo hoy

lines: Сам Бог как жизнь в нём весь.
Я мёртвым был — и стал живым,
Бог к древу Сам меня привёл,
Так входит Бога жизнь в меня,

suplemen.title: Tuhan Makanan Kita
suplemen.firstLine: Allah t'lah b'rikan Putra-Nya, jadi pohon hayat kita.

lines: Agar Di-a kita kecap, Dia makanan kita!
Dia makanan kita! Dia makanan kita!
Kita kecap dan saksikan, Dia makanan kita!
Betapa kaya dan limpah, Dia hidangan kita.
Dia hidangan kita! Dia hidangan kita!
Makan Tuhan, pamerkan Dia, Dia hidangan kita!
Menyup'lai kita d'ngan limpah, s'lalu kita makan.
S'lalu kita makan! S'lalu kita makan!
Menyup'lai kita d'ngan limpah, s'lalu kita makan!
Kini sia-pa saja ingin, boleh makan gratis.
Boleh makan gratis! Boleh makan gratis!
Kini sia-pa saja ingin, boleh makan gratis!

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: God gaf Zijn Zoon geheel voor ons

lines: God gaf Zijn Zoon geheel voor ons,
Als boom des levens rijk en vrij.
Dat heel het mensdom smaakt en ziet,
Ja, eet en drink van Hem!
Dit feestmaal eten brengt God in,
Ja, eet van Hem en leef door Hem.
Want heel dit feestmaal is bereid
Kom, eet van Hem en leef door Hem,
Ja, Christus is ons voedsel nu;
Hij is ons brood, Hij is ons vlees;
Dit feest genieten vol van vreugd,
Want Gods oproep aan ieder mens
Ja, kom en eet van Mij!
Ja, kom en eet van Mij!
Want Gods oproep aan ieder mens

en.name: English
en.title: God gave His Son to man to be

lines: God gave His Son to man to be
The tree of life so rich and free,
That every man may taste and see
That God is good for food.
Yes, God is good for food!
Yes, God is good for food!
That God is good for food!
We eat this feast and take God in,
And as we eat we live by Him,
We eat this feast and live by Him,
Christ Jesus is the food we eat;
He is our bread, He is our meat;

pt.name: Português
pt.title: Deus deu Seu Filho pra árvore da vida ser

lines: Deus deu Seu Filho, com prazer,
Pro homem vir, provar e ver
Deus disse: todo o que quiser
Deus disse: todo o que quiser

es.name: Español
es.title: Su Hijo a todo hombre, Dios

lines: Su Hijo͜ a todo hombre, Dios,
Cómo͜ árbol de la vida dio,
Para que pruebe͜ y vea hoy
El es el pan—nos nutre El,
Su vida͜ imparte͜ a nuestro ser
Su vida͜ imparte͜ a nuestro ser
Y Dios lo͜ ofrece hoy a ti,

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Gott gab den Sohn, dass Er uns sei

lines: Gott gab den Sohn, dass Er uns sei
Der Baum des Lebens, reich und frei,
Dass jeder schmeckt und sieht dabei:
Ja, Gott ist gut zur Speis!
Ja, Gott ist gut zur Speis!
Ja, Gott ist gut zur Speis!
Ja, Gott ist gut zur Speis!
Ein Festmahl ist's, wir essen Gott –
Wir leben nun durch Gottes Brot,
Da Gott Sich Selbst als Fest anbot,
Als Speise Sich der Herr erklärt,
Er ist das Brot, das uns ernährt,
Oh, welch Genuss ist dieses Fest!
Da Gott gern jeden kommen lässt,
Da Gott gern jeden kommen lässt,

Он нам как хлеб насущный дан.
Мы знаем: жизни в Нём запас
Мы знаем: жизни в Нём запас.

suplemen.title: Manusia Hidup Bukan Dari Roti Saja
suplemen.firstLine: Ma-nu-sia hidup bukan dari roti saja.
suplemen.chorusSnippet: Haleluya! Haleluya! Haleluya! Amin! Haleluya!

lines: Ma-nu-sia hidup bukan dari roti saja.
Tapi dari tiap firman dari mulut Allah.
Rohlah yang memb'ri hidup, daging tak berguna,
Firman yang Ku katakan, itu roh dan hayat.
Terimalah pedang Roh, yakni firman Allah,
Dalam segala do-a, do-a di dalam roh.
Dengan air dalam firman menyucikan g'reja,

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: Zoek eerst het koninkrijk van God

lines: Zoek eerst het koninkrijk van God
En dit alles krijgt u bovendien.
Bid en u zal gegeven zijn,
Zoek en gij zult het vinden,
Klop en de deur zal voor u opengaan.
Men kan niet leven van brood alleen,
Dat door de Heer gesproken wordt.

en.name: English
en.title: Seek ye first

lines: Seek ye first the kingdom of God
And all these things shall be added unto you.
Ask, and it shall be given unto you;
Knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
Man shall not live by bread alone,
That proceeds out from the mouth of God.

Tuhan Yesus, Kau sungguh agung, mu-lia,

ceb.name: Cebuano
ceb.title: O Ginoo, sa talad Mo nanambong

lines: O Ginoo, sa talad Mo nanambong,
Sa mga tawo sa daghang paagi.
Sa kadako Mo ug himaya, daygon,

en.name: English
en.title: O Jesus Lord, when present at Thy table

lines: O Jesus Lord, when present at Thy table,
And on the bread and on the wine we gaze;
We praise Thee, Lord, that Thou as food art able
To be enjoyed by man in many ways.
So all our being sings in praise to Thee,
How small Thou art, how small Thou art!
And Thee we’ll eat through all eternity;
How small Thou art, how small Thou art!
O what a shame—when Christ with all His riches,
Has come into the world, life to supply—
That man would live, not by Him, but by teachings,
So powerless these riches to apply.
But all we need to do is eat the Lord;
And as we eat, we’re inwardly restored;
Christ grows in us, grows to the full.
O Jesus Christ, Thou camest not to mankind
To be a king, to rule us outwardly.
But Thou hast come as food to satisfy us,
And by Thy life to guide us inwardly.
We praise Thee, Lord, for all Thy glorious grandeur,
For all Thy strength and majesty replete;
And yet, O Lord, what special thanks we give Thee,
That all Thou art is small enough to eat.

tl.name: Tagalog
tl.title: Panginoon, sa harap ng hapag Mo

lines: Panginoon, sa harap ng hapag Mo,
Purihin Ka, pagkain Ka ng tao,
Yaman ni Kristo’y dala Niya sa mundo,
Panustos ang buhay Niya sa tao,
Hesus, di Ka pumarito sa lupa
Senhor Jesus, à Tua mesa vimos,
Teu vinho e pão podemos contemplar;
E Te louvamos pois és alimento
Louvor a Ti entoa nosso ser:
Pequeno és Tu! Pequeno és Tu!
Por todo o sempre vamos Te comer,
Pequeno és Tu! Pequeno és Tu!
Que o homem preferisse os ensinos
E tais riquezas não quis aplicar.
Mas precisamos só de Ti comer:
Excelso és Tu! Glorioso és Tu!
Ao Te comermos vens nos refazer,
Senhor Jesus, ao homem não vieste
Para o reger de forma exterior,
Mas, como alimento que o sacia,
E o guia em vida no interior.
Oh! Te louvamos pois és tão grandioso,
Mas graças mui especiais Te damos
Pois o que és podemos, sim, comer.

es.name: Español
es.title: Señor Jesús, presentes en Tu mesa

lines: Señor Jesús, presentes en Tu mesa,
El vino͜ y pan podemos contemplar;
Todo mi ser canta͜ alabanza͜ a Ti,
Qué triste es, que Cristo vino͜ al mundo,
Con Sus riquezas para vida dar;
Mas vive͜ el hombre por las enseñanzas,
Y Sus riquezas no quiere͜ aplicar.
Pero͜ al Señor tenemos que comer;
El nos restaura al comer de El,
Señor Jesús, Tú no viniste͜ al mundo,
Más Tú viniste como͜ el alimento
Que͜ en vida nutre y nos guía͜ así.
Y te͜ alabamos por Tu gran poder;
Pero͜ especiales gracias hoy te damos,
Pues lo que eres se puede comer.

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Oh Jesus Herr, wenn wir an Deinem Tisch sind

lines: O Jesus Herr, wenn wir an Deinem Tisch sind,
Und dankbar Brot und Wein hier schauen an;
Dann preisen wir, dass Dich der Mensch als Speise
Auf manche Weise reich genießen kann.
Wir preisen Dich mit unsrem ganzen Sein,
Wie klein bist Du, wie klein bist Du!
Wir wollen essen ewig Dich allein;
Wie klein bist Du, wie klein bist Du!
Da Christus kam mit Seinem ganzen Reichtum
In diese Welt, Sein Leben uns anbot,
Wie traurig ist's: Der Mensch füllt sich mit Lehren,
Die kraftlos sind, anstatt mit Lebensbrot.
Doch wir solln Christus essen immer mehr,
Er ist so reich und wunderbar!
Durch Essen stellt Er uns nun wieder her,
Sein Wuchs in uns wird offenbar.
O Jesus Christus, Du kamst nicht zur Menschheit,
Um zu regiern als König äußerlich,
Und durch Dein Leben führen innerlich.
Wir preisen Dich, o Herr, für Deine Größe,
Für Deine Majestät und Kraft und Pracht;
Und doch, o Herr, besonders wolln wir danken,
Dass Du Dich klein und essbar hast gemacht.

О, как Ты мал! О, как Ты мал!
Тебя вкушать всю вечность будем мы.

Хотя Христос со всем Своим богатством
Явился в мир, чтоб жизнью всех снабжать,

И будет Он внутри нас укреплять,
И возрастёт тогда в нас Он.
Иисус Христос, не для того пришёл Ты,
Чтоб быть царём и внешне управлять,
А чтобы пищей стать, что насыщает,
О, как Ты мал! О, как Ты мал!
Тебя вкушать всю вечность будем мы.
О, как Ты мал! О, как Ты мал!
Господь Иисус, за силу и величье
Но как Тебе, Господь, мы благодарны,
Что Ты так мал, чтоб нам Тебя вкушать!
О, как Ты мал! О, как Ты мал!
Тебя вкушать всю вечность будем мы.
О, как Ты мал! О, как Ты мал!

en.title: Wholly, wholly, wholly back to the beginning

lines: Wholly, wholly, wholly back to the beginning—
God is in Christ Jesus now, and He is food to us.
In God’s recovery, we don’t know so much.
Loudly shouting, “Jesus!” Oh, it really feeds us!
We have found where Jesus is—He’s in the hungry mouth.
Not religious nodding, but recovered shouting—
In God’s recovery, we don’t know so much.
Chewing, chewing, chewing, not our outward doing,
Cease from all your working now, begin again to EAT.
Feasting, feasting, feasting, drop the old dead teachings—
In God’s recovery, we just know to EAT.

Tinggalkan gumul ronta, singkirkan s'mua yang usang.
Allah telah tetapkan, agar ma-nu-sia makan,
Lekas, nikmati hayat, ikatan teo-ri lepas,
Doktrin tak ubah jiwa, malah m'rusak maksud-Nya,

Y la͜ iglesia que͜ El soñó,

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: Eens riep Christus ons naar Hem

lines: Eens riep Christus ons naar Hem,
Nu roept Hij ons telkens weer.
Overwin het verval van het Christendom!
Het bereik ook Gods doel niet,
Eet Hem als het ene feest,
En de Heer we zullen zien;
Eet Hem en heb  geen gebrek;
Komt dan Zijn Bruid te voorschijn  -

en.name: English
en.title: Christ has called us once to Him

lines: Christ has called us once to Him,
But He calls us once again.
To His call we say Amen!
For the church has fallen low,
But the life is missing; so,
Overcome the degradation of the church!
Come enjoy the tree of life,
Leave the doctrines, leave the strife!
Eating Christ will do it all—
By ourselves and when we meet,
Eat Him as the feast complete—
Eating brings the Lord to earth;
Eat Him now midst all the dearth—
Thus the church that He desires,
Then the Bride that He admires—

fr.name: Français
fr.title: Le Christ nous a appelés

lines: Mais il lui manquait la vie :
De se remplir de la vie
Viens ! Prends l’arbre de la vie
Car pour vaincre, il faut manger,

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Christus rief uns einst zu Sich

lines: Christus rief uns einst zu Sich,
Nochmals ruft Er dich und mich,
Lasst Ihn länger nicht im Stich!
Weil sie sehr am Wissen hing,
Stets den Herrn zu essen pfleg –
Uns dem Bild des Herrn gleich trimmt,
Und dem Feind den Sieg ganz nimmt –
Stets dein Fest der Herr will sein –
Esst, dann kommt der Herr geschwind;
Essen stärkt, und euch sehr dient –
Seid das Kind, nach dem Er schaut,
Comer Cristo é a solução – Sim, vencer!

suplemen.firstLine: Minum! A-ir hayat mengalir dari takhta!
suplemen.chorusSnippet: "Mari!" kata Roh dan mempelai p'rem-puan,

lines: Minum! A-ir hayat mengalir dari takhta!
Kristuslah bu-ah hayat untuk ku nikmati;
Kristuslah surya, bintang fajar, dan siang hari;
Jubah kita bersih, layak makan buah hayat,
Kita latih roh kita untuk alami Dia –
Kini kita memiliki rumah nan terang,
¡Bebe! Fluye͜ un río desde͜ el trono del Señor;
¡Come!͜ El árbol de la vida con sus frutos hoy;
¡Mira!͜ Aquí no͜ hay sol ni luna͜ o luz artificial, pues
Cristo͜ el río, Cristo͜ el agua, fluye͜ en lo͜ interior;
Cristo͜ el árbol, Cristo͜ el fruto͜ es nuestro gozo hoy;
Cristo͜ el día, Cristo͜ el brillo, Cristo͜ el resplandor,
Hoy lavamos nuestras ropas para͜ así comer,
De͜ ese árbol de la vida, ¡Aleluya! ¡Amén!
Cuando ejercitamos nuestro͜ espíritu se ve ¡cuán
Ya tenemos un hogar que brilla más que͜ el sol,
Donde͜ en armonía los hermanos uno son;
Al reunirnos como͜ iglesia se muestra͜ al Señor en

ceb.name: Cebuano
ceb.title: Inom sa lunsayng suba nga gikan sa trono

lines: Inom sa lunsayng suba nga gikan sa trono;
Suga, Adlaw ug Bulan, di na kinahanglan,
Cristo atong suba ug tubig nga nagtubod;
Kahoy ug mga bunga napa’muslan’s sulod.
May balay kita nga mas masanag pa’s Adlaw,
Si Jesus ang nag-una, S’yay ipasundayag

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: Drink, het water rein en helder, stromend van de troon

lines: Drink, het water rein en helder, stromend van de troon.
Eet, de boom des levens, aan weerszijden van de stroom.
Zie, er is geen lamp, noch zon, noch maan, die ons verlicht.
Want hier is God ons licht!
Laat hem die dorst en wil
Hij ons leven, Hij ons licht en Hij de morgenster.
Hij ons water, Hij ons brood, dat ons tevredenstelt.
Hij de boom en Hij de vruchten, rijp en vol en zoet.
Onze kleren zijn gewassen door Zijn kostbaar bloed.
O Heer, Amen, Halleluja - Jezus is zo zoet!
De weg tot de boom des levens is volkomen vrij.
O, wat een Christus is Hij!
God, als onze wederzijdse woning schijnt alom.
Waar de broeders zijn verenigd in het heiligdom.
Jezus brengt ons allen samen, als een priesterdom.

en.name: English
en.title: Drink! A river pure and clear that’s flowing from the throne

lines: Drink! A river pure and clear that’s flowing from the throne;
Eat! The tree of life with fruits abundant, richly grown;
Look! No need of lamp nor sun nor moon to keep it bright, for
Let him who thirsts and will
Take freely the water of life!
Christ, our river, Christ, our water, springing from within;
Christ, our tree, and Christ, the fruits, to be enjoyed therein,
Christ, our day, and Christ, our light, and Christ, our morningstar:
We are washing all our robes the tree of life to eat;
“O Lord, Amen, Hallelujah!”—Jesus is so sweet!
We our spirits exercise, and thus experience Christ.
Now we have a home so bright that outshines the sun,
Where the brothers all unite and truly are one.
Jesus gets us all together, Him we now display
Uminom! May ilog na umagos sa trono;
Kumain! May puno ng buhay, bunga’y puno;
Di na kailangan ang ilaw pagka’t tingnan mo
Lapit o lapit, o magpaunlak na.
Kristo—ang tubig ng Buhay sa loob natin;
Kristo—ang Ilaw at manining na Bituin:
Puno ng buhay kanin, at damit linisin;
Ang tahanan nati’y tunay na mal’walhati,
Sa pagpupulong natin, Siya ang tinatanghal

fr.name: Français
fr.title: Bois au fleuve pur qui sort du trône de l’Agneau

lines: Bois au fleuve pur qui sort du trône de l’Agneau,
L’arbre de la vie pousse au milieu de ce cours d’eau.
Christ est la lumière qui nous éclaire et conduit :
Il n’y a plus de nuit !
Car Christ est l’eau de la vie.
Christ est l’eau de la vie et la source qui jaillit.
Lui aussi est l’arbre de la vie qui nous nourrit,
La lumière et le jour, notre approvisionnement
Nous lavons nos robes pour avoir droit à la vie.
Nous exerçons notre esprit pour L’expérimenter,
Nous avons enfin trouvé l’église, Sa maison.
Ici, tous ensemble, pour Son Corps nous nous donnons !
Jésus nous rassemble et en nous est manifesté,

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Trink! Vom klaren Strom, der sich aus Gottes Thron ergiesst

lines: Trinkt! Vom reinen, klaren Strom, aus Gottes Thron er fließt;
Esst! Vom Baum des Lebens, Seine Früchte jetzt genießt;
Seht! Gar keine Lampe, Sonn noch Mond mehr braucht's als Licht,
Denn hier die Nacht gibt's nicht!
Christus, unser Strom und Wasser springt aus uns heraus;
Christus, unser Baum und Frucht, genießen wir daraus;
Christus, unser Tag und Licht und unser Morgenstern;
Wascht die Kleider und den Baum des Lebens froh genießt,
„O Herr, Amen, Halleluja!“ – Jesus ist so süß!
Üben alle unsren Geist, um Christus zu erfahren.
Ein Zuhause haben wir, das wie die Sonne scheint,
Wo die Brüder alle eins sind und im Herrn vereint.
Jesus baut uns all zusammen, Ihn wir stellen aus
Bebe! há um rio; vem do trono a jorrar;
Come! os frutos d’árvore da vida a fartar;
Vê! não há mais lâmpada nem mesmo luz solar,
Vem, o Espír’to e a Noiva dizem: Vem!
Vem, o que ouve há de clamar também.
Vem, quem tem sede, de graça agora tem
Cristo, nosso rio, flui do nosso interior;
Cristo, nossa Árvore, Seu fruto tem dulçor;
Cristo, nosso Dia, Luz, Estrela de esplendor,
Limpas nossas vestes para a Árv’re desfrutar;
“Ó Senhor Jesus, amém!” – quão bom é invocar!
Nosso espír’to exercitamos para O tocar;
Temos uma casa mais brilhante que o sol,
Onde todos os irmãos de fato são um só;
Para exibi-Lo foi que Cristo nos juntou

fa.title: بِنوش! نهرِ پاک و صاف كه از تختش جاريست؛

lines: بِنوش! نهرِ پاک و صاف كه از تختش جاريست؛
بخور! درختِ حيات با وفورِ ميوه؛
ببين! نياز نيست به نورِ لامپ، خورشيد و ماه، چون
مسيح، نهرم، مسيح، آبم، درونم جاريست؛
مسيح، درخت، مسيح، ميوه، شادم در او،
مسيح روزم، مسيح نورم، ستارۀ صبح:
جامه ها شسته، درخت حيات مى خوريم؛
با تمرينِ روح ما تجربه كنيم مسيح.
خانه اى داريم كه تابان تر از خورشيد است،
آنجا كه برادران راستى يكى هستند.
عيسى جمع كرده ما را، او را نشان دهيم
Пей! Исходит от престола чистая река.
Посмотри! Нужды нет в свете солнца и луны —
«Приди!» — кто жаждет, пусть воду жизни пьёт,
Наш Христос — река, вода, течёт Он из глубин,
Он и древо, и плоды, чтоб наслаждаться Им,
День, и свет, и утренняя светлая звезда —
«Приди!» — кто жаждет, пусть воду жизни пьёт,
Чтоб от древа жизни есть, одежды убелим;
Он так сладок — аллилуйя! О Господь! Аминь!
«Приди!» — кто жаждет, пусть воду жизни пьёт,
Светлый дом у нас такой, что солнце он затмил;
Братья здесь все вместе стали истинно одним.

«Приди!» — кто жаждет, пусть воду жизни пьёт,

suplemen.title: Aliran Air Hayat
suplemen.firstLine: Marilah! Marilah! Ke Ba-it Allah. Di sana ada aliran air hayat.

lines: Di sana ada aliran air hayat.
Di kanan, siang malam, 'ngalir tak sudah.
Ya, Tuhan! Ukurlah hari ke hari,
Hingga kami nampak air jadi sungai,

tl.name: Tagalog
tl.title: Pumasok tayo sa tahanan ng Diyos

lines: Pumasok tayo sa tahanan ng Diyos;
Kung saan ang tubig ay umaagos.
Araw man o gabi, tuloy ang agos,
Ang buhay na dala, para sa mundo.
Sana ay pakinggan ang aming samo;
Kaming lahat nawa ay puspusan Mo.
Hanggang sa makita, ilog ng buhay,
Sa agos na ito, nawa’y dalhin Mo;
Minsan at minsan pa, dito magtungo.
Hanggang sa ang tubig, malanguyan ko,
At kami’y mababad sa biyaya Mo.
Ang lahat, ang lahat ay mabubuhay;
Sa ilog na dala’y tubig ng buhay.

en.name: English
en.title: We have come, we have come to the house of God

lines: We have come, we have come to the house of God;
We have come to the house, whence outflows the flood.
On the right, day and night, constant is its flow,
Watering us and causing fruits of life to grow.
From the house, from the house flows this living stream,
From the house, to the earth, with the life supreme.
Yet more deep, Lord, we seek that the flow may be;
Thus we must be measured and possessed by Thee.
Measure us, measure us, measure every day;
Measure us, measure more, measure all the way,
Till we know that the flow is a mighty flood,
Sweeping over all the earth for Christ the Lord.
Take us through, take us through, take us through the flow;
Take us through, through and through, everywhere we go.
Flow increase, never cease, till we swim in Thee,
Till we are immersed in God eternally.
All shall live, all shall live where the river comes;
All shall live, really live, everywhere it runs.
Let the fount from this mount life abundant bring,
Till the deserts of the earth with churches spring!
Vimos já, vimos já, à casa do Senhor,
Donde flui, donde flui, um rio interior,
Tal fluir, a suprir, nunca cessará,
Nos fará crescer e frutos vivos dar.
Flui aqui, flui aqui, aonde quer que vá,
Vida, sim, aos confins, a todos levará;
Um clamor, ó Senhor, temos, pois a Ti:
Mais e mais nos vem medir e possuir.
Vem medir, vem medir, mede sem cessar,
Vem medir, vem medir, ‘té não poder cruzar;
E o fluir a se expandir cheio de vigor,
Inundando a terra toda, ó Senhor.
Neste rio, neste rio, leva-nos Senhor,
Sim, nos vem conduzir aonde quer que for;
Cresce mais e nos faz mergulhar em Ti,
E estar imersos por todo o porvir.
Aonde quer que ele vá – onde o rio passar,
Esse rio tão sadio traz propagação,
E em toda a terra igrejas brotarão.

es.name: Español
es.title: Al hogar, al hogar, al hogar de Dios

lines: Al hogar, al hogar, al hogar de Dios,
Donde͜ está͜ el manantial he venido yo,
Un fluir hay aquí que no cesará,
Y͜ hace crecer vida hasta madurar.
Fluye͜ aquí, fluye͜ aquí un río que va,
Por la tierra͜ a proveer la vida͜ especial;
Pero ve, oh Señor, más profundo aún,
Hasta que nos midas y poseas Tú.
Hasta ver que͜ el fluir, torrente de Dios,
Inunde la tierra por Cristo͜ el Señor.
Llévanos más y más, todo͜ hay que medir;
Fluye más, sin cesar, por la͜ eternidad,
Vivirá en verdad donde͜ el río͜ está,
Una fuente saldrá para vida dar,

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Wir sind jetzt, wir sind jetzt schon bei Gottes Haus,

lines: Wir sind jetzt, wir sind jetzt schon bei Gottes Haus,
Wir sind jetzt bei dem Haus, wo der Strom fließt aus;
Von dem Ort immerfort fließt das Wasser stets,
Das für uns die Lebensfrüchte wachsen lässt.
Von dem Haus, von dem Haus Lebenswasser quillt,
Von dem Haus fließt heraus, Durst der Erde stillt;
Tiefer noch soll jedoch dieses Fließen sein,
So kannst Du uns messen, nimmst uns völlig ein.
Miss uns, Herr; miss uns, Herr; miss uns jeden Tag;
Miss uns, Herr; miss uns mehr; was es kosten mag,
Bis der Fluss werden muss eine starke Flut,
Und die Erde überschwemmt für unsren Gott.
Bring uns durch, bring uns durch, hoch die Wasser stehn,
Bring uns durch, ganz hindurch, wohin wir auch gehn;
Höher geht’s, steigend stets, bis in Dir wir schwimm’n,
Bis wir in Gott bleiben, eingetaucht in Ihn.
Alles lebt, alles lebt, wo der Strom auch fließt,
Alles lebt, wirklich lebt, wo er sich ergießt;
Fließen soll, übervoll, uns das Leben bringt,
Bis der Erden Wüsten voll Gemeinden sind.

ko.name: 한국어
ko.title: 돌아와 돌아와 주의 집으로 생명 강 흐르는

lines: 돌아와 돌아와 주의 집으로 생명 강 흐르는
주의 집으로 주야로 끝없이 흘러 내리네
주님의 집에서 생명 강 흘러 온 땅을 적시며
생명 강 흘러 생명수 넘치기 나 참 원하네
우리를 측량해 매일 측량해 측량할 수 없이
매일 넘치네 끝없이 넘치어 생명 강 됐네
이 강 물을 마시는 자 살겠네
우리를 인도해 흐르는 물에 우리를 인도해
다 사네 다 사네 모든 만물이 생명 강 흘러서
영원히 사네 풍성한 생명수 흐르는 물에
Мы пришли, мы пришли в дом, где Бог живёт,
В дом, где справа поток день и ночь течёт,
Пока Божья жизнь свои плоды не даст.
К нам из дома поток тот живой течёт,
Но хотим тот поток больше углубить:
Нас, Господь, измерь, чтоб больше захватить.
Измеряй, измеряй Ты нас день за днём,
Измеряй больше нас, измеряй во всём,
Для Христа по всей земле не потечёт!
О, веди, да, веди нас через поток,
Чтобы, где б мы ни шли, он свободно тёк,
Возрастая, пока в нём не поплывём,
Погрузившись в Бога, чтоб быть вечно в Нём.
Где течёт тот поток, там всё оживёт,
В нём действительно жить всё везде начнёт.

Pastor guiar, La sed en tu espíritu saciar.

en.name: English
en.title: I thirsted in the barren land of Babylon

lines: I thirsted in the barren land of Babylon
And nothing satisfying there I found;
But to the blessed local church one day I came,
Where springs of living water do abound.
Drinking at the springs of living water,
Drinking at the springs of living water,
How sweet the living water from the hills of God,
It’s flowing in and flowing out of me;
O now I’ve found the place for which I long had sought,
Where there is life and life abundantly.
O brother, won’t you gather in the local church?
A fountain here is flowing deep and wide.
The Shepherd now would bring you to the local church,
Where thirsty spirits can be satisfied.

Ako’y masaya, puso ko’y may si-ya;
Tubig buhay kay tamis mula sa trono,
Bukal na nagpatid ng uhaw nakita,
Bakit di magpulong sa ekklesia lokal?
Dito’y tuloy ang daloy ng bukal.
Kayo’y dadalhin ng Pastol sa ekklesia,
Só tinha sede lá na Babilônia,
Mas à igreja na localidade vim –
Bebo só dos rios d’água viva;
Bebo só dos rios d’água viva;
Quão doce é a água a jorrar de Deus,
Oh, flui em mim e a partir de mim.
Achei o Seu lugar que tanto procurei –
Irmão, por que não vens às ricas reuniões?
A fonte jorra sempre, dá prazer;
O teu Pastor deseja te levar ali,

Daygon ang Dios! Niinom na’s tuboran!

en.name: English
en.title: Of Him whence grace and truth did spring

lines: Of Him whence grace and truth did spring,
This Christ we’ll ever praise and sing,
Here in the church, His home!
Glory to God! We’re at the fountain drinking!
Glory to God! We’re in the church, our home!
Ask but His grace, and lo, ’tis giv’n,
Seek but Himself, the heaven of heaven,
And find Him here at home!
Though Satan fights with all his power,
He’ll not prevail, not one short hour,
Athirst we to this spring do fly,
Drink deep, this well will not run dry!
It’s in the church, our home!
Glória a Deus! Bebemos desta fonte!
Glória a Deus! Aqui é nosso lar!
E se o mal nos atacar,
Não vai vencer o Corpo Seu,

en.name: English
en.title: Breath by breath we breathe the Lord

lines: Breath by breath we breathe the Lord.
Breath by breath He quickens us.
Yes, He breathes out and we breathe in,
And deeply flows His life within,
For we’ve all learned how to deeply breathe the Lord.
The Wind blows where it wills, it wills,
We cannot tell from whence it comes;
We cannot tell to where it runs;
So is everyone who’s of the Spirit born.
Jesus breathed the Breath of Life
He only asked us to receive—
’Tis not to think, but only breathe;
And it’s by this Breath that we experience Life.
So brothers, sisters, breathe the Breath of Life.
Just by calling on His Name,
Christ becomes the breath to us,
We breathe His Name from deep within
And breathe until we’re filled with Him,
And what a Breath this Jesus is to us!

suplemen.title: Yesus, Nama Mustika
suplemen.firstLine: Tuhan dekat pada orang yang menyeru-Nya!
suplemen.chorusSnippet: Yesus, nama indah! Tuhan Yesus, beri hayat!

lines: Tuhan dekat pada orang yang menyeru-Nya!
Cari Yesus. 'kan bertemu; seru, Dia dekat.
Kita pun terhibur, karna Dia sungguh mesra!
Yesus, nama indah! Tuhan Yesus, beri hayat!
Yesus, nama kua-sa! Tuhan Yesus, beri hibur!
Asal seru nama Yesus, kita selamat.
Tuhan Yesus, haleluya, lepas s'mua kekang!
Terhadap yang menyeru-Nya, Dia sungguh kaya.
Tuhan Yesus, Tuhan Yesus, sungguh gembira!
Susah, senang, d'rita, bah'gia, tetap berseru!
Asal aku masih hidup, ku 'kan berseru,
Kitalah orang yang berseru pada Tuhan,
D'ngan orang yang suci hati, t'rima berkat-Nya.
O Senhor, daqueles que O invocam, perto está;
Se O invocamos, Ele Seu vigor nos dá.
A Jesus buscando, sempre pronto se nos faz;
Seu nome invocar, oh! que consolo que nos traz!
Jesus! nome tão bom! Este nome dá vida a nós!
Vitorioso, glorioso, exaltado, que nome é!
Jesus! Força nos dá, este nome consolador!
A Jesus invoque, salvo então você será,
“Ó Senhor Jesus” e Ele o libertará!
Tome agora assim o cálice da salvação;
Provê-nos o Seu nome grandiosa salvação.
Ao Senhor, judeus e gregos, todos são iguais,
Aos que O invocam, o Seu rico ser lhes traz.
Ó Senhor Jesus, que alegria é Te invocar!
Ao respirar Teu nome quanto gozo nos vens dar.
Desfrutamos sempre o Deus da nossa salvação
E invocamos o Seu nome em toda situação.
Invocar Seu nome em todo o meu viver eu vou,
Porque os Seus ouvidos para mim Ele inclinou.
Invocamos o que é digno de total louvor;
Nosso grato coração adora o Senhor.
Oh! sigamos a justiça, a fé, a paz, o amor
Co’os que de puro coração invocam o Senhor!

en.name: English
en.title: O how nigh the Lord is unto all who call on Him

lines: O how nigh the Lord is unto all who call on Him!
When we call, His very presence strengthens us within.
Seeking Jesus, He is found, and calling, He is near—
O what a comfort to our hearts to call His name so dear!
Name to breathe in prayer, calling everywhere,
“O Lord Jesus!” O what a name!
Call upon the name of Jesus, and you will be saved,
O Lord Jesus, hallelujah, nevermore enslaved!
We may take salvation’s cup by calling on the Lord;
Salvation from a host of things does His dear name afford.
To the Lord, the Jew, the Greek and everyone’s the same;
He is rich unto all men that call upon His name.
O Lord Jesus, what a joy to call and really live;
When breathing in Thy name, what pleasure Thou
In the God of our salvation we may take delight,
Calling on His name at all times, though in bliss or blight.
I will call upon His name as long as I shall live,
Because He has inclined His ear, and grace so full does give.
We will call upon the Lord, who’s worthy of our praise;
Thus our grateful hearts in worship we to Him may raise.
We are those who call upon His name in every place
With all the saints who from a pure heart call and taste His grace.

ceb.name: Cebuano
ceb.title: Unsa kaduol S’ya’s tanang motawag Niya

lines: Unsa kaduol S’ya’s tanang motawag Niya!
Maglig-on sa sulod ta ang Iyang presensya.
Mangita, mapalgan S’ya, motawag, duol S’ya.
Unsang kalipay’s pagtawag’s mahal nga ngalan N’ya!
Tawga ang ngalan ni Jesus, ug maluwas ka,
Hallelujah, di ka na gyud maulipon pa!
Madawat sa pagtawag ta kopa’s kal’wasan;
Kaluwasan’s daghang butang ang hatag’s ’yang ngalan.
Sa mga Judio ug Gresyanhon, S’ya sama ra,
Sa tanang motawag’s Iyang ngalan dato S’ya.
Unsang kalipay nga makaginhawa’s ngalan Mo.
Magkalipay ta’s Dios sa atong kaluwasan,
Sa tanang panahon magtawag sa ’yang ngalan,
Ikiling N’yang igdulongog, ug grasya hatagan.
Tawgon nato ang ngalan N’ya nga takus daygon;
Kita ang nanawag’s ’yang ngalan’s tanang dapit
Uban sa tanang putli’g kasingkasing mosangpit.

nl.name: Nederlands
nl.title: Jezus! O, wat een Naam!

lines: Naam zo heerlijk, Naam zo lieflijk,
Naam verheven, o, wat een Naam!
Naam die mensen redt, Naam voor in ’t gebed.
“O, Heer Jezus!” O, wat een Naam!

de.name: Deutsch
de.title: Oh wie ist der Herr uns nah, wenn wir Ihn rufen an

lines: Oh, wie ist der Herr uns nahe, rufen wir Ihn an!
Seine Gegenwart uns stärkt und zieht uns neu voran;
Jesus lässt Sich finden, wenn du rufst, ist Er gleich da –
Oh, welch ein Trost für unser Herz zu wissen Er ist nah!
O Herr Jesus! Wie Leben fließt!
O Herr Jesus! Trost uns verschafft!
Atmet ihn doch ein, ruft tagaus, tagein,
O Herr Jesus! Oh, welch ein Nam!
Ruf den Namen Jesus an, Er macht dich völlig frei,
O Herr Jesus, Halleluja, Knechtschaft ist vorbei!
Trink den Kelch der Rettung, dass Er dich beleben kann;
Uns von so vielem rettet Er, wenn wir Ihn rufen an.
Für den Herrn sind Juden, Griechen, alle Menschen gleich;
Und wer Seinen Namen ruft, für den ist Er so reich.
O Herr Jesus! Freudig ruf ich Dich und Leben fließt;
Ich atme Deinen Namen ein, der süß und lieblich ist.
Über unsren Retter-Gott erfreuen wir uns sehr,
Ob in Wonne, ob in Kummer rufen wir: „O Herr!“
Seinen Namen ruf ich an, solang ich leben werd,
Sein Ohr hat Er mir zugeneigt, gibt Gnade mir vermehrt.
Ja, den Herrn wir rufen an und geben Ihm die Ehr,
Dankbar und aus ganzem Herzen preisen wir Ihn sehr.
Ruft mit allen Heiligen Ihn an an jedem Ort,
Aus reinem Herzen rufen wir, und Gnade fließt sofort.

es.name: Español
es.title: Cerca está el Señor a los que invocan

lines: Cerca͜ está͜ el Señor a los que͜ invocan por doquier.
Si clamamos, Su presencia͜ alienta nuestro ser.
Al buscarle le͜ encontramos en nuestro clamar.
¡Oh, qué consuelo͜ al corazón Su nombre invocar!
Se puede͜ inhalar en cualquier lugar,
Clama al Señor Jesús y salvo tú serás.
Copa de la salvación tomamos al clamar,
De multitud de cosas salvación Su nombre da.
Para el Señor, judío͜ o griego es igual,
A cualquiera que le͜ invoque Sus riquezas da.
¡Oh Señor Jesús! Qué gozo͜ es clamar y vivir;
Al respirar Tu nombre qué placer haces sentir.
¡Hay delicias en el Dios de nuestra salvación!
A Su nombre clamaremos en cada͜ ocasión.
En desgracia o͜ alegría clamaré͜ al Señor,
Porque Su͜ oído͜ inclina y Su gracia nos da Dios.
Clamaremos al Señor, que͜ es digno de loor,
Nuestras alabanzas El merece con honor.
Somos los que claman a Su nombre por doquier,
Con los de puro corazón gozamos gracia de͜ El.

fa.name: فارسی
fa.title: چه نزدیک است خداوند به خوانندگانش

lines: چه نزدیک است خداوند به خوانندگانش!
چون خوانیم، به ما نیرو می بخشد حضورش.
سراغش گیر، مهیاست؛ بخوانش، نزدیک است –
خواندنش چه تسکینی برای دلهای ماست!
نامت چون دعاست، نفَس در هر جاست،
نام عیسی را بخوان و نجات خواهد داد،
ای خداوند، هللویاه، نه هرگز در بند!
جام نجات را برگیر با خواندن عیسی؛
نام عزیزش نجات دهد از خیلی چیزها.
او غنی ست به هر کسی که نامش را خواند.
خداوندْ عیسی، خوش است خواندن و زیستن ات؛
هرگاه نفَس می کشیم ما نام لذت بخش ات.
در خدای نجاتمان شادی می کنیم،
در شادی یا غم، مدام نام او را خوانیم.
نامش را تا دَمِ آخر صدا خواهم زد،
چون گوش سپرده است و به وفور فیض می بخشد.
و ما از او در پرستش قدردانی کنیم.
ما در هر کجا نامش را صدا می زنیم
با مقدسین که از قلبی خالص می خوانند.
О, Господь так близок к призывающим Его!
Мы зовём — и Он приходит, силу нам даёт.
Ищущий Его найдёт, к зовущим близок Он;
Как утешает Он сердца, когда Его зовём!
Призови Иисуса имя, будешь ты спасён,
Мы спасенья примем чашу, Господа призвав,
Спасенье от всего Его благое имя даст.
Иудеи, греки — все пред Господом равны;
Он богат для тех, кто имя призывать верны.
«О Господь!» — какая радость призывать и жить.
Вдыхая Твоё имя, Твою сладость будем пить.
В Боге нашего спасенья — вся отрада мне;
Призываю Его имя в счастье и в беде.
Я всю жизнь свою Иисуса буду призывать,
Он ухо приклонил ко мне и дарит благодать.
Призывай! Господь достоин! Пой Ему хвалу!
В поклонении сердца возносим мы к Нему,
Призывая Его имя всюду и всегда,
Мы со святыми с чистым сердцем вкусим благодать.

en.name: English
en.title: Our Lord, that One of peerless worth

lines: Our Lord, that One of peerless worth
Came first to die to give new birth;
He comes again to have on earth
Jesus! may our hearts make room
What our dear Lord desires the most,
Is not to just redeem the lost;
But that some saints would pay the cost,
As virgins we must single be,
No other husband could have we,
That when He comes we’ll then be free
How could we love this fading world,
When Christ desires that one great pearl;
To Him we must our love unfurl

fr.name: Français
fr.title: Il vient d’abord seul pour mourir

lines: Il vient d’abord seul pour mourir,
Afin de nous donner la vie,
La seule attente de Son cœur,
C’est que Ses saints soient tout à Lui,
Chacun de nous peut se parer,
En ne vivant que par Lui !
Quand Christ languit de se marier ?
